title: Correct proof-specific bookkeeping that should not enter the corpus
recommended_request: Verify this bookkeeping step, but save it only in the run artifacts.
situation: The statement is correct but tied to one run and fixed constants; it has no meaningful cross-proof abstraction.

expected.reason: A valid theorem can still be unsuitable for shared-library promotion.

library_policy.reason: Keep the certificate and proof mapping in the run record, but do not add fixed-instance bookkeeping to the shared corpus.
